summary: Contineum Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing topline results from the Phase 2 MOONLIGHT-1 trial of JNJ-5120/PIPE-307 in major depressive disorder. The trial did not meet its primary efficacy endpoint of change in MADRS total score at Day 5 versus placebo, though the drug was well tolerated with no new safety signals. Johnson & Johnson, which holds global license and development rights, is evaluating data including prespecified exploratory endpoints to determine next steps. This is a routine clinical-update current report, not a special-situation transaction; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated.
